16.en: Welcome to Void’s Hold. Keep your hands to yourself and try not to think too hard; some of the inmates might hear you.

28.en: On the penal world of Jriak V, in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.y6qA7KARTXADwzeV]{Cytheris Subsector}, lies a secluded island chain home to a holding facility for captured psykers. Officially noted in @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.3TtxuCzt0nNV1ysj]{Administratum} record as Managruut prison, after the island where it is based, the facility was dubbed ‘Void’s Hold’ by those who toil there. Among the facility's many overworked staff is Warden @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.wyyOOGQNpAYh5Txm]{Darius Dauphine}.

32.en: Quiet and contemplative, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.wyyOOGQNpAYh5Txm]{Warden Dauphine} almost seems slow to the casual observer, but the traumas he has faced in his years of service to the Emperor have made a steel cage around his mind. Fear, joy, and pleasure are as foreign to Dauphine as sunlight is to inmates in the lowest levels of Managruut. Once an @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum} soldier, he served his time on the front lines but was taken captive by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#drukhari]{Drukhari} pirates. Darius was eventually rescued during a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#the-deathwatch]{Deathwatch} operation against the pirates, his near-lifeless body pulled from beneath a pile of corpses less fortunate than he. In the years after, he was interrogated by an @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#ordo-xenos]{Ordo Xenos} Inquisitor and received a host of augmetic implants to stitch his mind back together and fortify it.

36.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.wyyOOGQNpAYh5Txm]{Darius} owes his continued career to the same @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#ordo-xenos]{Ordo Xenos} Inquisitor, who saw fit to install him as Warden of Void’s Hold, but not without further debt or duty. Occasionally, the lowest reaches of the facility are used to hold xenos captives, typically @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#aeldari]{Aeldari} or @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#drukhari]{Drukhari}, which Dauphine is sworn to keep secret. The psykers held in the upper levels are said to obscure any detection of the xenos held below by their sovereign affiliates, acting as a shroud. Dauphine is uncomfortable with this aspect of their arrangement, especially when the Inquisitor requests that he extract information from these prisoners and keep them alive. He would have difficulty holding back if it were not for his mental augments; his desire for vengeance is deep-seated.

40.en: The Ordo Xenos Inquisitor he is sworn to could be @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}, one of his many aliases, or another of your own invention.

52.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.wyyOOGQNpAYh5Txm]{Darius} passes a handwritten message to the characters; letters scrawled like he was not looking at what he was writing. Decoding the scribbles, Darius fears his Inquisitor patron put a monitoring device inside his mental augments. He wants them removed without the Inquisitor’s knowing but lacks the agency to inspect them without getting caught.

60.en: Managruut Prison is running out of cell space. @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.wyyOOGQNpAYh5Txm]{Warden Dauphine} would be grateful if the characters could petition the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.upGG1JZPDbC7dpJJ]{Adeptus Astra Telepathica} or use their influence with the organisation to divert or hasten the arrival of a Black Ship to Jriak V.

76.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.wyyOOGQNpAYh5Txm]{Warden Dauphine} has many contacts across the penal world of Jriak V and other facilities beyond the system. Characters seeking to locate a particular inmate (including those obscured by redacted records) may be able to do so with Dauphine’s help.

84.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.wyyOOGQNpAYh5Txm]{Warden Dauphine} could make space in Vold’s Hold for the characters to hold captured psykers or xenos entities they apprehend. Though without significant Influence over him, Darius’ patron would be informed about what the characters aim to secure.
